claims.text: The Congress party announced it will launch a series of protests under the banner 'Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao' to demand the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
The Congress party claims 130 million eligible voters have been deleted from India's electoral rolls.
Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge and Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi led a preparatory meeting with party leaders to plan the nationwide campaign.
The Congress party invited the DMK and AAP to participate in an INDIA bloc march to the Election Commission on Tuesday and a rally at Ramlila Maidan on November 1.
The AAP exited the INDIA alliance following the Lok Sabha elections, while the DMK parted ways with Congress in June after Congress supported the TVK government.
Congress general secretary KC Venugopal announced that block-level protests, bike rallies, and effigy burnings of Gyanesh Kumar will occur between October 10 and October 20.
Congress plans six protest yatras from Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, and Rajasthan on November 25 and 26 to mark Constitution Day.
Chief Justice of India Surya Kant stated in court, 'any modification to Form 6 has not been approved by us. Let's be clear.'
Rahul Gandhi posted on X that Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar changed Form 6 illegally and unilaterally to assist the BJP.

The Election Commission of India posted on X that Rahul Gandhi's statements were misleading, stating the Special Intensive Revision order for Bihar was unanimously approved and upheld by the Supreme Court on May 27, 2026.
The Press Information Bureau fact-checked claims by Cockroach Janta Party's Ashutosh Ranka, stating the Election Commission's September 26, 2026 press release remains publicly available.

Election Commission officials clarified that Form 6 itself was not changed, but an additional declaration form, Annexure D, was introduced under the Special Intensive Revision documentation framework.

On September 29, the Election Commission removed the requirement for the additional declaration form in states and Union Territories where Special Intensive Revision was completed or had not yet started.
The Supreme Court declined to issue an interim order suspending Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and instead sought responses from the ECI and Union government.

A Supreme Court bench consisting of Chief Justice Surya Kant, Justice Joymalya Bagchi, and Justice V. Mohana issued notices to CEC Kumar, Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi, and Deputy Election Commissioner Maneesh Garg.
The Indian Express reported on September 23 that Election Commissioners Sandhu and Joshi formally objected 14 times in 10 months to decisions regarding the Special Intensive Revision.
A petition filed in the Supreme Court requested an investigation into the deletion of 13.8 crore voters across 31 states and Union Territories.
Senior counsel Vikas Singh, representing petitioner Rakesh Singh, argued before the Supreme Court for an immediate restraint on Chief Election Commissioner Kumar to safeguard electoral credibility.
US President Donald Trump stated he personally believes Iran was responsible for the flydubai incident, saying 'I do. I personally do.'
US Vice President JD Vance stated regarding Iranian involvement, 'I wouldn't say I've seen anything conclusively just yet.'
The UAE is leading an international investigation into a September 30 attack aboard a flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv carrying 170 passengers.
An Omani co-pilot attacked flight captain Smit Machchhar with a crash axe in an attempt to crash a flydubai flight at Ben Gurion Airport.
US President Donald Trump stated that B-1 bombers were moved from their UK base due to fresh terror threats.
Acting CEO of flyadeal Sanjiv Kapoor praised Captain Smit Machchhar's actions, calling them 'sheer heroic activity' and 'ultimate heroism'.
The co-pilot who attacked Captain Machchhar was identified as Omani national Hamam Alhammami.
Investigators believe 29-year-old Hamam al-Hammami originally planned his attack on a flydubai flight for July before postponing it.
Hammami launched his attack approximately two hours and 20 minutes after takeoff on flydubai flight FZ1073.
Hammami worked for Oman Air from 2018 until June 2025, when he was reassigned to a desk job due to concerns over extremist views.
Captain Machchhar unlocked the cockpit security door, allowing passengers to overpower Hammami before a reserve pilot landed the plane in north-western Saudi Arabia.
Captain Smit Machchhar suffered severe injuries to his head, chest, and hands during the confrontation in the cockpit.
The Delhi government withheld the current duty charge assignment of Additional Deputy Commissioner of Police given to ACP Vivek Bhagat following sexual harassment allegations.
ACP Vivek Bhagat voluntarily requested not to take up the current duty charge until a full enquiry into the allegations is completed.
Three women journalists accused Delhi Police officers of sexual harassment during an October 3 protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar at Jantar Mantar.
The Delhi Police forwarded the sexual harassment complaints received from women journalists to the Crime Branch for further inquiry.
The proposal to confer current duty charge to 12 DANIPS officers was initiated on August 25 and approved on October 5.
ACP Vivek Bhagat serves as Sub-Divisional Police Officer (SDPO) of Connaught Place.
The Delhi Police called physical assault allegations against female protesters 'baseless and misleading', stating female staff handled female protesters with dignity.
The Delhi Police issued guidelines advising journalists covering protests to visibly display valid organisation or PIB/DIP accreditation cards.
One journalist alleged ACP Bhagat pushed and sexually assaulted her when she questioned the absence of female police personnel during protester detentions.
A woman journalist who alleged ACP Bhagat sexually harassed her was detained for a second time on Monday outside Parliament Street police station.
Seventeen people were detained alongside the journalist on Monday, with Cockroach Janta Party's Ratna Singh alleging that police assaulted the detainees.
Digipub News India Foundation demanded that FIRs be registered against the police officers accused of sexually harassing women journalists.
